title: Amortizing Exact Orthogonality: Drift-Triggered Restoration for Orthogonal Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33589v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Orthogonal finetuning (OFT) adapts a pretrained weight by an orthogonal transform and preserves its singular values and row angles, but existing methods construct an exact or approximate orthogonal transform at every optimization step. We measure how far a transform $A$ is from orthogonal by its orthogonality defect $\|A^\top A-I\|_2$. For OFTv2, which truncates a Cayley-Neumann series, we show that the truncation order does not determine the defect. At its default order, block defects in checkpoints from the reference implementation span five orders of magnitude. translated_title: 摊销精确正交性：面向正交微调的漂移触发恢复方法
translated_abstract: 正交微调（OFT）通过正交变换来适配预训练权重，并保持其奇异值和行间角度，但现有方法在每次优化步骤中都需要构造精确或近似的正交变换。我们通过正交性缺陷 ‖AᵀA−I‖₂ 来衡量变换 A 偏离正交的程度。对于截断 Cayley-Neumann 级数的 OFTv2，我们证明截断阶数并不能决定缺陷大小：在默认阶数下，参考实现检查点中的分块缺陷跨越五个数量级。我们提出重启切线正交微调，它使用带斜对称矩阵 S 的权重 W 的一阶更新 W(I+S)，并且仅在漂移 ‖S‖₂ 达到容差 τ 时，才通过极分解恢复精确正交性。由于 I+S 的缺陷恰好为 ‖S‖₂²，因此只需在每次更新后读取漂移，并在……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 RTOFT 方法，用一阶更新 W(I+S) 取代逐步构造正交变换，仅在漂移 ‖S‖₂ 超过容差 τ 时才通过极分解恢复精确正交性，从而以漂移触发的方式摊销正交微调的计算开销。
en_tdlr: RTOFT amortizes the cost of exact orthogonality in orthogonal finetuning by using first-order updates W(I+S) and restoring exact orthogonality via polar decomposition only when the drift ‖S‖₂ exceeds a tolerance τ.
